strategies.text: Hard auto-attacks from Grubbis and Chomper. Stun and focus one at a time; avoid cleaving.
Nature auto-attacks ignore armour, so armour does not help. Stuns and Demoralizing Shout / Roar reduce the damage.
Chain Bolt chains lightning to nearby players, Megavolt is a frontal nature hit (face him away) and Shock hurts the tank. Spread out and stun.
Arcing Smash is a frontal hit, Crowd Pummel knocks players back and Trample hits everyone close. Fight near a wall so nobody is knocked off a ledge; ranged stand left and right of him.
Fireball, Fire Shield II (melee take damage) and a Burning Servant add. Patrols with other Dark Irons; pull only when nothing else is near.

Walking Bombs drop from the pillars; pressing the pillar buttons stops them. Knock Away cuts threat sharply, so the tank taunts back; give a ranged player the job of killing bombs and pressing buttons.

notes: Floor names follow OpenMap's journal data; the map picture of floor 2 labels its rooms 'Hall of Gears', 'Dormitory' and 'Launch Bay'. Five boss positions are OpenMap (Encounter Journal) data. OpenMap's Places.lua also lists a sixth boss, 'Mechanical Menagerie', not mentioned by Method: it is included without a position. NeedRoll's pins differ (Viscous Fallout on floor 1, Electrocutioner and Crowd Pummeler swapped); OpenMap's agree with the room tints on the map picture and are used. The Dark Iron Ambassador (rare patrol, floor 4) has no position. Floor transitions are not on the map art. Method: the main entrance is the portal on floor 1; the back entrance needs the Workshop Key from Electrocutioner 6000. Horde can use Chief Engineer Scooty (Booty Bay teleport). Quest NPCs inside: Kerbonee (The Clean Room, 'A Fine Mess'); Blastmaster Emi Shortfuse starts the pre-Grubbis trogg-cave event. Neither has a position.
